The medicine beside the chair.
The Side Tables and Lighting in the Living Room. Put a light, a drink and one or two personal things within reach of the chair without turning the table into a nightstand.

What done looks like:
1. One small tray per table with no more than four items on it
2. A coaster under the glass
3. A bulb that lights
4. Has been wiped
